summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 87,337 of its own book-entry common shares, each with ARS $1 par value and one vote, on BYMA under Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. The trade date was September 9, 2026, with settlement September 10, at an average price of ARS 2,246.09 per share, totaling ARS 196,167,548. The repurchases represented less than 25% of the average daily trading volume over the prior 90 business days, mitigating market-impact concerns.
